names: Sodium phosphates (i) Monosodium phosphate (ii) Disodium phosphate (iii) Trisodium phosphate

more_info.uses: EU permissions include milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, casings and coatings and decorations for meat. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 40 mg phosphorus/kg body weight/day, combined phosphates (EFSA, 2019).
more_info.side_effects:
Estimated combined exposure exceeded the limit in some groups.
Animal evidence supports low acute toxicity.
more_info.overview: Sodium phosphates is classified in food technology as an antioxidant. Its technological role is to slow oxidation.
